tools.name: perpetual_status
tools.description: Free. Service status and, per symbol (AMC, GME), whether a current roadmap run is available to buy, its last completed session and data freshness.

tools.name: perpetual_preview
tools.description: Free. Provenance preview of the current roadmap run for AMC or GME: data providers, cross-check, reference archive, input hash. Does not include the projection.

tools.name: perpetual_x402_contract
tools.description: Free. x402 v2 payment terms for the paid HTTP endpoint GET /v1/roadmap/{symbol}: price, network, asset, payTo and header names. Payment is made over HTTP, not through this tool.
